processors.typeDescription: Emits a FlowFile per tick; content and batch size configurable via EFM.

File Size.name: File Size
File Size.description: The size of the file that will be used.

Batch Size.name: Batch Size
Batch Size.description: The number of FlowFiles to be transferred in each invocation.

Data Format.name: Data Format
Data Format.description: Specifies whether the data should be Text or Binary.

Unique FlowFiles.name: Unique FlowFiles
Unique FlowFiles.description: If true, each FlowFile will be unique. If false, a fixed payload is reused for higher throughput.

Custom Text.name: Custom Text
Custom Text.description: If Data Format is Text and Unique FlowFiles is false, this text is used as the FlowFile content.

processors.typeDescription: Logs FlowFile id, attributes, and optionally content to ESP-IDF logger.

Log Level.name: Log Level
Log Level.description: The Log Level to use when logging the Attributes.

Log Payload.name: Log Payload
Log Payload.description: If true, the FlowFile's content will be logged in addition to its attributes.

Log prefix.name: Log prefix
Log prefix.description: An optional identifier prepended to each log line for this processor.

Attributes to Log.name: Attributes to Log
Attributes to Log.description: A comma-separated list of attributes to log. If blank, all attributes are logged.

Attributes to Ignore.name: Attributes to Ignore
Attributes to Ignore.description: A comma-separated list of attributes to exclude from logging.

processors.typeDescription: Publishes the input FlowFile's content to an MQTT broker topic.

Broker URI.name: Broker URI
Broker URI.description: The URI of the MQTT broker, e.g. mqtt://host:1883.

Client ID.name: Client ID
Client ID.description: MQTT client identifier. If blank, esp-mqtt derives one.

Topic.name: Topic
Topic.description: The topic to publish the FlowFile content to.

Quality of Service.name: Quality of Service
Quality of Service.description: MQTT QoS level (0, 1, or 2) for the publish.

Username.name: Username
Username.description: Username for an authenticated broker. Leave blank if none.

Password.name: Password
Password.description: Password for an authenticated broker. Leave blank if none.

processors.typeDescription: Adds/overwrites literal-value attributes on the FlowFile from up to 4 configured name/value slot pairs (no Expression Language evaluation).

Attribute 1 Name.name: Attribute 1 Name
Attribute 1 Name.description: Name of the first attribute to set.

Attribute 1 Value.name: Attribute 1 Value
Attribute 1 Value.description: Literal value for the first attribute.

Attribute 2 Name.name: Attribute 2 Name
Attribute 2 Name.description: Name of the second attribute to set.

Attribute 2 Value.name: Attribute 2 Value
Attribute 2 Value.description: Literal value for the second attribute.

Attribute 3 Name.name: Attribute 3 Name
Attribute 3 Name.description: Name of the third attribute to set.

Attribute 3 Value.name: Attribute 3 Value
Attribute 3 Value.description: Literal value for the third attribute.

Attribute 4 Name.name: Attribute 4 Name
Attribute 4 Name.description: Name of the fourth attribute to set.

Attribute 4 Value.name: Attribute 4 Value
Attribute 4 Value.description: Literal value for the fourth attribute.

processors.typeDescription: Reads a configured GPIO pin's digital level (0/1) on every tick and emits it as FlowFile content.

GPIO Pin.name: GPIO Pin
GPIO Pin.description: GPIO number to read (e.g. 0 for the onboard BOOT button).

Pull Mode.name: Pull Mode
Pull Mode.description: Internal pull resistor to enable on the pin.

processors.typeDescription: Starts an HTTP listener; each POST to the configured Base Path becomes a FlowFile. Fire-and-forget ack (matches MiNiFi C++'s ListenHTTP, not the synchronous HandleHttpRequest/HandleHttpResponse pairing).

Listening Port.name: Listening Port
Listening Port.description: TCP port to listen for inbound HTTP POSTs on.

Base Path.name: Base Path
Base Path.description: URI path this listener answers on (e.g. /contentListener).

processors.typeDescription: Drives a configured GPIO pin's digital level when triggered -- fixed high/low/toggle or parsed from the FlowFile content (1/0/toggle).

GPIO Pin.name: GPIO Pin
GPIO Pin.description: GPIO number to drive (e.g. 21 for the XIAO ESP32-S3 onboard user LED -- pair with Invert=true, it is active-low).

Pin Level.name: Pin Level
Pin Level.description: Level to drive on each trigger. from-content reads the FlowFile content: 1/high/on, 0/low/off, or toggle.

Invert.name: Invert
Invert.description: If true, the physical output is the inverse of the logical level -- for active-low wiring like the XIAO onboard LED.

processors.typeDescription: Captures a JPEG frame from the onboard OV2640 camera, publishes the image bytes to an MQTT topic, and emits a metadata FlowFile (seq/bytes/dimensions/topic as JSON) on success.

Broker URI.name: Broker URI
Broker URI.description: The URI of the MQTT broker the JPEG frames are published to.

Image Topic.name: Image Topic
Image Topic.description: MQTT topic the raw JPEG bytes are published to.

Client ID.name: Client ID
Client ID.description: MQTT client id. Blank derives <agent-id>-cam. Keep distinct from any PublishMQTT client on the same device.

Frame Size.name: Frame Size
Frame Size.description: Camera resolution for the JPEG capture.

Capture Every N Ticks.name: Capture Every N Ticks
Capture Every N Ticks.description: Capture one frame every N engine ticks (1 tick = 1 s).

processors.typeDescription: Publishes Sparkplug B NBIRTH/NDATA for a single float metric to an MQTT broker.

Broker URI.name: Broker URI
Broker URI.description: The URI of the MQTT broker, e.g. mqtt://host:1883.

Group ID.name: Group ID
Group ID.description: Sparkplug group id -- the <group> segment of spBv1.0/<group>/... topics.

Edge Node ID.name: Edge Node ID
Edge Node ID.description: Sparkplug edge node id. Blank derives it from the agent class.

Client ID.name: Client ID
Client ID.description: MQTT client identifier. If blank, esp-mqtt derives one. Must be distinct per MQTT-owning processor on one device.

Metric Name.name: Metric Name
Metric Name.description: Name of the single float metric declared in NBIRTH and reported in NDATA.

Metric Source.name: Metric Source
Metric Source.description: Where the metric value comes from: the S3's internal temperature sensor, or the FlowFile content parsed as a float.

Scan Rate.name: Scan Rate
Scan Rate.description: Sparkplug scan rate in milliseconds -- the node samples tags and considers an NDATA at most this often.
